_comment: Current probes (Strategy keeps this up to date). name -> level (relative to driver_personal/chicago), optional build (exe folder, default build-dev). python driver_personal/probes.py sync publishes each as a self-contained copy in <Desktop>/Driver Probe Tests/NAME (OneDrive -> laptop). NOTE: 'env' only feeds the PACKAGE BUILD (converter/build_package switches); runtime/plugin switches (e.g. CHI_C88_*) are NOT passed to the running game, so a runtime variant needs its own build/default.

d2 cities 2.what: Probe 'd2 cities 2' (= havana 2 + Las Vegas + Rio + dark night roads in Havana/Las Vegas/Rio like Driver 2) (3-disc). NEW: Las Vegas and Rio on page 2 of the city menu (Day/Night, own picture, sky, music + chase music, Driver 2 cars and car sounds, traffic-light glows, pause-menu map; Rio's sea drowns you; both start you in Driver 2's normal car). From havana 2: Havana chase music; Chicago/Havana Driver 2 engine + traffic sounds; pause-menu map in all Driver 2 cities (centred on you, d-pad pans, other buttons close; Driver 1 cities unchanged); reworked Uncap/Extra draw speed guard. Known: police sirens are still Driver 1's; Las Vegas lake is walled (no drowning there); Rio misses 2 special cars; Rio textures partly half resolution; Havana lights glow on the middle lamp only; ferries do not move; Chicago/Havana still start in the secret car (Q69).
